full_prompt_en: A square landscape painting looks through a narrow passage of dark blue water between steep rock walls. On the left, ochre and golden stone faces step down toward the water in blocky planes. A line of very slender dark evergreen trees stands along their upper edge, some rising high into the sky. On the right, a massive violet-brown cliff fills the foreground, its fractured surfaces arranged in broad angular slabs. A pale sloping rock shelf enters the water near the lower right corner. The two walls open toward a distant band of blue hills at the center, where the water narrows almost to a line. Calm reflections repeat the left golden cliffs and dark tree points in the lower left, while deeper cobalt and indigo ripples spread across the foreground and right. Above the gap, large cream-white clouds pile up in rounded forms against a saturated blue sky. A darker gray-violet cloud mass presses in from the very top, giving the bright cloud bank more weight. The viewpoint is low and nearly level with the water, inviting the eye through the canyon-like opening. Strong sunlight touches the left rock faces and parts of the cloud, while the right cliff and foreground pool stay largely in cool shadow. The painting uses distinct outlining strokes, broken color planes, and visible brush texture rather than seamless photographic blending. Orange-gold stone, dark green pines, cobalt water, blue-violet rock, and creamy cloud make a vivid but structured palette. The frame contains no people, boats, buildings, or readable text. The whole scene feels quiet and monumental, with still water balancing the dense vertical cliffs and billowing sky.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形风景画从陡峭岩壁间望向一条狭窄深蓝水道。左边，赭黄和金色石壁以块状平面层层降到水边。一列极细的深色常青树立在岩壁上缘，有些高高刺入天空。右边，巨大的紫褐色悬崖占据前景，断裂表面被组织成宽阔棱角石板。浅色倾斜岩台从右下角伸进水面。两面岩壁向中央远处的蓝色山丘带打开，水道在那里收窄得几乎成一条线。平静倒影在左下重复金色峭壁和深色树尖，更深的钴蓝和靛蓝水纹则铺满前景与右侧。开口上方，大团奶油白云在饱和蓝天下层层堆起。更深的灰紫云块从顶部压入，使明亮云团显得更有重量。视点低，几乎与水面平齐，把目光引向峡谷般的缺口。强日光落在左边岩面和部分云上，右崖与前景水池大多留在冷色阴影中。绘画用明确的勾边笔触、断续色面和可见刷痕，而非无缝照片渐层。橙金石色、深绿松树、钴蓝水、蓝紫岩壁和奶白云组成鲜明而有组织的配色。画框里没有人、船、建筑或可读文字。整幅场景安静而宏大，静水平衡密集竖崖与翻涌天空。
style_prompt_en: Post-impressionist landscape painting builds rugged forms from outlined angular color planes and short, visibly directional brush strokes. Warm ochre and gold stand against deep cobalt, blue-violet, and dark evergreen, with rounded cream cloud masses adding a softer countershape. A narrow central opening draws the eye through heavier masses on both sides. Still reflective water repeats selected vertical colors while retaining its own broken horizontal strokes. Sunlit planes and cool shadow blocks are cleanly separated without losing tactile pigment texture. Slender upright marks punctuate the rock edges; distant hills soften into layered blue bands. The mood is bold, quiet, and monumental, with strong color structure carrying the sense of place.
style_prompt_zh: 后印象派风景绘画以带边线的棱角形色面和短而方向明确的可见笔触搭建粗粝形体。暖赭黄与金色对照深钴蓝、蓝紫和常青深绿，圆润奶白云块提供较柔软的反形。中央狭窄开口把视线引过两侧较重的体块。平静反光水面重复若干竖向颜色，同时保留自身断续水平笔触。受光平面与冷色阴影块清楚分开，却不失可触颜料肌理。细长竖痕点在岩缘，远山柔化成层层蓝带。气氛大胆、安静而宏大，由强烈色彩结构承载场所感。
theme_en: A narrow blue water passage between pine-topped rock walls
theme_zh: 松树覆盖的岩壁之间一条狭窄蓝色水道
name: Arthur Lismer
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
